instruction: In VS Code, replace all instances of 'data' with 'date' across the entire document using the find-and-replace tool.

command:
text = """The data for the meeting has been set for next Monday.
Please ensure that all participants are aware of the data and time.
If you need to change the data, please inform the team at least two days in advance.
The data was chosen to accommodate everyone's schedule.
We look forward to seeing you on that data."""
with open('/home/user/Desktop/vscode_replace_text.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(text)
